settings.retention: Keep erased members' names in the log for (days)
settings.retention_help: After this, an anonymized or deleted member's log entries keep only their ID and counts. Until then their email and IPs are kept only as salted hashes: pseudonymous, not anonymous (someone holding the database and this forum's secret could test guesses), so they are removed too.

confirm.no_gdpr: Anonymizing needs the GDPR extension (flarum/gdpr). Without it, Delete uses Flarum's own user delete.
confirm.deletion_off: Deleting is turned off in the GDPR extension's settings, so only anonymizing is offered.
confirm.admin_group_note: The Admin group can only be given on a member's own page, one at a time.

kept.anonymize: Kept: their {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} and {discussions, plural, one {# discussion} other {# discussions}} stay, credited to an anonymous name, and their post counts.
kept.delete: Kept: a log entry for each, with their username, groups and counts. Their email and IPs are kept only as salted hashes (pseudonymous, not anonymous), and all of it except the counts is removed after the retention period.
kept.spammer: Nothing is deleted. You can restore everything this hides from the member's page.
kept.suspend: Nothing is deleted. They can still read, but can't post until the suspension ends.

gone.anonymize: Wiped: names, emails, avatars, groups, preferences and sessions. Each member is emailed that their data was erased. This can't be undone.
gone.delete_gdpr: Deleted: the accounts and their {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, through the GDPR extension. Each member is emailed that their data was erased. This can't be undone.
gone.delete_core: Deleted: the accounts. Their {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} stay, shown as from a deleted member. This can't be undone.
gone.spammer: Each one is suspended until you lift it, and their {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} and {discussions, plural, one {# discussion} other {# discussions}} are hidden.
gone.spammer_ban: Each one is suspended until you lift it, their {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} and {discussions, plural, one {# discussion} other {# discussions}} are hidden, and their IPs are banned (unless an active member shares one).

info.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {They're all verified already; nothing will change.} one {# of them isn't verified yet; the rest are left alone.} other {# of them aren't verified yet; the rest are left alone.}}
info.signOut: They'll be signed out on every device and need to sign in again.
info.unspam: Their hidden posts and discussions come back, the IPs this banned are unbanned, and the suspension is lifted.
